# Blandede bankregnskaber og vaklende chip-aktier - markedet savner gode nyheder

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-10-14  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish episode of Millionærklubben (Euroinvestor), with technical analyst Lars Persson and guest Philip Gunst of Implement. Oil stays high near $106 because of Middle East tensions, so Lars favours oil and tanker stocks such as Torm, Chevron and Marathon. US bank results were mixed, and memory-chip stocks fell on worries about Chinese competition from CXMT. Much of the episode covers Philip's high-conviction, long-held position in Colonial Coal, a Canadian coking-coal company he expects to be sold.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 CAD — Colonial Coal | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Guest Philip has held it since 2020 at an average cost just under 2 and expects a takeout at $8-12 per share versus 2.41 today. Canadian politics now looks favourable.

#### Reasoning

Colonial holds 695Mt of coking coal, the largest undeveloped deposit of its kind, in the Peace River coalfield next to Glencore and Anglo American mines. Demand from India and China should rise for decades. The company has been in accelerated sale talks with state-owned buyers. Mark Carney is pushing trade deals with India and China, and a British Columbia election on 24 October could speed up a deal. Philip sees a very asymmetric payoff but admits the case is speculative and dependent on politi

#### Sell Triggers

- new prime minister hostile to deals with China or India
- diplomatic conflict between Canada and China or India
- talks with possible buyers collapse
- guest's patience runs out because the sale keeps dragging on

> *"jeg regner med, at vi kan få 8 dollar per aktie, 10 dollar per aktie, 12 dollar per aktie, og den handler i 2,41"*

---

### 🟢 TRMD-A — Torm | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Lars bought after the share fell on its dividend and keeps holding it while oil stays high and tankers face supply risks.

#### Reasoning

High oil prices and attacks on tankers around Hormuz support earnings. Lars uses the drop after the dividend as an entry point and keeps the position. He cites Global Risk Management's view that the market underestimates supply risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- oil price falls back sharply
- de-escalation in the Middle East or Hormuz

> *"Gør det, du holder fast i din tårgmarked? Jamen helt sikkert, ja"*

---

### 🟢 CVX — Chevron | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lars bought it back, hoping for a bounce as the US-Iran deal hopes fade. Venezuela gives production upside.

#### Reasoning

With oil near $106 and Iran reportedly trying to keep prices high, oil majors should earn more. Chevron could also lift production in Venezuela. Lars re-entered after selling too early.

#### Sell Triggers

- US-Iran agreement brings oil prices down
- oil price falls

> *"Så jeg har også købt Chevron tilbage og håber på en lille vup op."*

---

### 🟢 MPC — Marathon | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars bought this US oil stock as part of his oil and gas exposure.

#### Reasoning

Lars thinks investors should still consider oil and gas while crude and gas prices stay high and earnings may exceed expectations.

#### Sell Triggers

- oil price falls

> *"jeg købte også nogle Marathon"*

---

### 🟠 PARKEN — Parken Sport & Entertainment | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Up 16% on renewed sale talk. Lars regrets not owning it and sees it as a stock to trade in and out of, but much may already be priced in.

#### Reasoning

There is repeated speculation about selling the football club or other assets, and the owner seems tired of being a football investor. The host notes that much of the possible price may already be reflected after the 16% jump.

#### Sell Triggers

- no takeover bid materialises

> *"Jeg er lidt ærgerlig over, at jeg ikke er inde i den igen"*

---

### 🟠 ROCK-B — Rockwool | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Lars thinks it is turning and that it can pass higher energy costs on to customers. Higher energy prices also support demand for insulation.

#### Reasoning

The market worried about energy costs, but Rockwool raised guidance earlier in the year. Lars does not believe its margin has been eaten up, and expensive energy increases the need for insulation.

#### Sell Triggers

- unable to pass energy costs on to customers
- margin pressure in the next report

> *"så jeg regner ikke med, at den er blevet spist, selvom energipriserne er steget voldsomt"*

---
